operating_income.source: not found: operating income is not reported in the deskstack XBRL data for PFE; not estimated

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: flat near term given FY2025 revenue -1.6% and FY2023-25 CAGR 2.5% (key_metrics); patent-expiry headwinds offset by new launches, recovering to about the CAGR

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: historical EBIT not available from the data tool. A proxy of pretax income plus interest expense (FY2025: 7,520+2,671=10,191, 16.3% of revenue) is depressed by intangible amortization, so I assume 20% with cost-savings; reviewer should replace it with the 10-K operating income.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: blended effective rate between the US statutory 21% and Pfizer's lower foreign rates; Damodaran industry effective rate is only 3.0%, so I did not use it

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta 1.02 x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran) = 9.4% cost of equity. Beta is the unlevered cash-corrected 0.915 relevered at D/E 0.145 and a 21% tax rate. Pre-tax cost of debt 6.02%, 4.5% after tax (Damodaran). Weights 87.3% equity and 12.7% debt (Damodaran industry) give about 8.8%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal growth below the 4.86% risk-free rate and in line with inflation; mature pharma

net_debt.source: deskstack derived net_debt = total debt 64,795 (LTD noncurrent 61,641 + current debt 3,154) - cash 1,142 - short-term investments 9,183; accession 0000078003-26-000026
